title: UAE airports see flight cancellation, delays: List of Dubai and Abu Dhabi arrivals, departures running late
summary: Flight connectivity between the UAE and global destinations is disrupted due to renewed US-Iran conflict. Heightened security is affecting multiple airports, leading to delays across airlines including Etihad and Air Arabia.
